
AUDIT-COVERAGE
Verify that test files and implementation files referenced in coverage mappings actually exist

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command after refactoring to verify file paths are still correct, or periodically to detect broken coverage links. Essential before deploying or after moving files. Catches issues where tests/implementation were deleted but coverage file was not updated.

USAGE
  fspec audit-coverage <feature-name> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <feature-name> (required)
    Feature file name (without path or extension), e.g., "user-authentication"

OPTIONS
  --fix
    Automatically remove broken mappings from coverage file

COMMON PATTERNS
  • After Refactoring
    Example: # Moved test files to new directory structure
mv src/__tests__/auth/* src/auth/__tests__/

# Audit all features to find broken links
fspec list-features --format=json | jq -r '.[].name' | while read feature; do
  fspec audit-coverage "$feature"
done
    undefined

  • Fix Broken Links Automatically
    Example: # After deleting obsolete test files
fspec audit-coverage user-authentication
# Shows broken links

# Auto-fix (removes broken mappings)
fspec audit-coverage user-authentication --fix
    undefined

  • CI/CD Validation
    Example: # In CI pipeline, fail if any coverage links are broken
fspec audit-coverage user-authentication || exit 1
    undefined


TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  1. Refactor/move files → 2. fspec audit-coverage → 3. Fix broken paths manually OR use --fix → 4. Verify with fspec show-coverage

EXAMPLES
  1. Audit coverage for specific feature
  $ fspec audit-coverage user-authentication
  Auditing: user-authentication.feature

✓ Login with valid credentials
  ✓ Test file exists: src/__tests__/auth.test.ts
  ✓ Implementation file exists: src/auth/login.ts

✗ Login with invalid credentials
  ✗ Test file missing: src/__tests__/auth-error.test.ts
  ✓ Implementation file exists: src/auth/login.ts

Audit Summary:
- 2 scenarios checked
- 1 fully valid
- 1 has broken links

Run with --fix to remove broken mappings

  2. Audit and automatically fix broken links
  $ fspec audit-coverage user-authentication --fix
  Auditing: user-authentication.feature

✗ Login with invalid credentials
  ✗ Test file missing: src/__tests__/auth-error.test.ts
  Removed broken test mapping

✓ Fixed 1 broken mapping

  3. Audit coverage after moving files
  $ fspec audit-coverage dashboard
  Auditing: dashboard.feature

✓ View dashboard metrics
  ✓ Test file exists: src/__tests__/dashboard.test.ts
  ✓ Implementation file exists: src/dashboard/metrics.ts

All mappings valid! ✅

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Error: Feature file user-authentication.feature not found
    Fix: Check feature name matches file name. Run: fspec list-features

  ✗ Error: Coverage file user-authentication.feature.coverage not found
    Fix: Coverage file should auto-create with fspec create-feature.

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-coverage
  fspec link-coverage
  fspec unlink-coverage

NOTES
  • Does NOT validate that line numbers are correct, only that files exist
  • Use --fix to automatically remove broken mappings (backup first!)
  • Run after moving or renaming files to catch stale references
  • Essential part of refactoring workflow to maintain coverage integrity
  • Does not modify feature files, only .coverage files
